meta.title: Lba Rda And Council Formal Meeting

votes.motion: Approve the meeting minutes of April 18, 2023; May 2, 2023; May 16, 2023; June 6, 2023; and June 13, 2023 (LBA).
votes.description: The Local Building Authority board approved several prior meeting minutes from 2023.

votes.motion: Approve Resolution 01 of 2024, adopting the tentative budget for the Capital Projects Fund of the Local Building Authority of Salt Lake City, Utah for Fiscal Year 2024-25.
votes.description: The LBA adopted its tentative FY2024-25 budget covering bond debt service for the Glendale and Marmalade Libraries.

votes.motion: Adjourn the LBA meeting.
votes.description: The Local Building Authority board voted to adjourn its portion of the meeting.

votes.motion: Approve Resolution 05 of 2024, adopting the tentative budget for the Redevelopment Agency of Salt Lake City, Utah for Fiscal Year 2024-25.
votes.description: The RDA board adopted its tentative FY2024-25 budget for the Redevelopment Agency.

votes.motion: Adjourn the RDA meeting.
votes.description: The Redevelopment Agency board voted to adjourn its portion of the meeting.

votes.motion: Approve the formal meeting minutes of February 20, 2024 and April 2, 2024.
votes.description: The City Council approved its formal meeting minutes from two prior sessions.

votes.motion: Close the Public Hearing and refer Items H-1 and H-2 to a future Consent Agenda for action.
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on two grant applications (WFRC one-way street study and Comcast Project UP digital literacy) and referred them to a future consent agenda.

votes.motion: Close the Public Hearing and defer action on the Ballpark Station Area Rezone and Text Amendments to a future Council meeting.
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on proposed zoning map and text amendments for the Ballpark Station Area, including creation of the new MU-8 zone, and deferred final action.

votes.motion: Close the Public Hearing and defer action on the MU-8 Zone Sign Text Amendments to a future Council meeting.
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on proposed sign regulations for the new MU-8 zoning district and deferred final action.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing, evaluate potentially modifying the boundaries, and defer action on the Northpoint Area Annexation Initiation to a future Council meeting.
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on the proposed Northpoint area annexation and directed staff to evaluate potential boundary modifications before returning for further action.

votes.motion: Close the Public Hearing and adopt Ordinance 29 of 2024 (Attached Garages Zoning Text Amendment).
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing and adopted an ordinance updating City code on attached garage standards to align with 2021 state law changes.

votes.motion: Close the Public Hearing and defer action on the Rezone at approximately 536 South 200 West to a future Council meeting.
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on a proposed rezone from D-2 to D-1 for properties near 536 South 200 West and deferred final action.

votes.motion: Close the Public Hearing and adopt Ordinance 30 of 2024 (Zoning Map Amendment at 1050 West 1300 South).
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing and adopted an ordinance rezoning a City-owned property at 1050 West 1300 South from R-1/5,000 to RMF-30 to support multi-family housing consistent with the Westside Master Plan.

votes.motion: Close the Public Hearing and adopt Ordinance 31 of 2024, amending the Fiscal Year 2024 final budget of Salt Lake City including the employment staffing document for specified items, and direct the City to seek reimbursement for Item A-8 from the Utah Fairpark Area Investment and Restoration District.
votes.description: The Council adopted Budget Amendment No. 5 for FY2023-24, approving select items including a 2100 South utility upgrade loan program, North Temple bridge repairs, a CIP fund balance allocation, a Housing Authority PILOT payment, and micro-shelter community site costs.

votes.motion: Close this Public Hearing on the Metropolitan Water District FY2024-25 property tax proposal and refer to the next Public Hearing on the May 21, 2024 agenda.
votes.description: The Council closed the first public hearing on the Metropolitan Water District's proposed property tax increase and continued the matter to a second hearing on May 21, 2024.

votes.motion: Close the Public Hearing and adopt Ordinance 32 of 2024, replacing the 1996 Transportation Master Plan with Connect SLC as the Citywide Transportation Plan.
votes.description: The Council adopted the 2023 Connect SLC Citywide Transportation Plan, replacing the prior 1996 plan with updated goals, policies, and implementation actions.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 33 of 2024, subject to the conditions outlined in Attachment A, with added development agreement language limiting Package Delivery Facility accessory use to no more than 25 percent of gross square footage of any building (Zoning Map Amendments at approximately 2760, 2800, and 2828 North 2200 West).
votes.description: The Council approved a rezone of approximately 14.33 acres from AG-2 to M-1 for three properties on 2200 West, with conditions including a cap on package delivery facility use.

votes.motion: Amend and adopt Ordinance 34 of 2024, permitting vinyl windows in local historic districts only as an affordable housing incentive per chapter 21A.52, so long as they are not readily visible from the street.
votes.description: The Council adopted an ordinance regulating window standards in local historic districts for new construction, allowing vinyl windows only when not street-visible and used as part of an affordable housing incentive.

votes.motion: Initiate a legislative action for City staff to research and draft an ordinance allowing live performance theater use (indoor or outdoor) in the General Commercial zone and other appropriate districts.
votes.description: The Council initiated a legislative action to study and draft zoning changes permitting outdoor live performance theater in the General Commercial zone and similar districts.

votes.motion: Initiate a legislative action for City staff to research and draft an ordinance changing the protection period for reconstructed historic buildings from 25 to 50 years.
votes.description: The Council initiated a legislative action to extend the required protection period for reconstructed historic buildings from 25 to 50 years under City ordinance.

votes.motion: Suspend the rules and adopt Ordinance 35 of 2024, amending the Consolidated Fee Schedule to modify certain fees related to recreational facilities.
votes.description: The Council amended the FY2023-24 Consolidated Fee Schedule to reduce Athletic Facility Reservation and Twilight Golf Green Fees, with the City to reimburse the difference in fees for the past two years.

votes.motion: Approve Resolution 13 of 2024, adopting the tentative budget for Salt Lake City, Utah, including the tentative budget of the Library Fund, for Fiscal Year 2024-25.
votes.description: The Council adopted the tentative FY2024-25 budgets for Salt Lake City and the Library Fund, initiating the process leading to final budget adoption.

votes.motion: Adopt the Consent Agenda.
votes.description: The Council approved the consent agenda items, including setting public hearing dates, board appointments, and a daycare zoning ordinance clarification.

votes.motion: Adopt the LBA Consent Agenda.
votes.description: The LBA board adopted its consent agenda, setting public hearing dates for the final FY2024-25 Capital Projects Fund budget.
